mechanism_narrative: Sustained elevated RESIDENTIAL mobility indicates households are voluntarily limiting out-of-home activity, which depresses discretionary retail footfall and keeps RETAIL_REC below its prior level over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its mean over the last 28 days despite RESIDENTIAL remaining above 5 percent change from baseline.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT mobility falls below -20 percent change from baseline in a given week, commuter flows collapse, removing incidental retail trips and driving RETAIL_REC lower over the following week.
failure_condition: In weeks following a TRANSIT reading below -20, RETAIL_REC rises or stays flat relative to the prior week in more than 50% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of GROCERY_PHARM above 10 and PARKS below -15 signals household hunkering and reduced outdoor leisure, which together suppress retail-and-recreation visits over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM > 10 and PARKS < -15 simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Under a reopening-pause regime, simultaneous declines in WORKPLACES and rises in RESIDENTIAL indicate renewed stay-at-home directives that cut retail traffic for at least four weeks.
failure_condition: During a reopening-pause regime, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days despite WORKPLACES < -10 and RESIDENTIAL > 8.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in PARKS mobility below -15 indicates reduced outdoor activity and associated retail trips, predicting lower RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When PARKS falls below -15, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp one-week drop in RETAIL_REC at t-0w is an overreaction to temporary news; as households adapt, retail footfall mean-reverts upward over the next four weeks, lifting the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: After a single-week RETAIL_REC drop below -15, the next 28-day mean is lower than or equal to the prior 28-day mean in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Stringent policy proxies (TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both below -20 and -10 respectively) jointly signal lockdown enforcement that suppresses retail and recreation for four weeks.
failure_condition: When TRANSIT < -20 and WORKPLACES < -10 simultaneously, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not lower than over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: July summer heat typically boosts PARKS mobility but reduces indoor retail travel; when PARKS rises above -10, retail declines over the next two weeks due to seasonal substitution.
failure_condition: When PARKS rises above -10 in July, RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days in more than 50% of observations.
